title: Unpack the first three countries and the scandic rest
description:
['China', 'Russia', 'USA', 'Finland', 'Sweden', 'Norway', 'Denmark']. Unpack the first three countries and the rest as scandic countries.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as unpack_scandic_countries(countries), taking a list whose first three items are non-Scandinavian and the rest are Scandinavian, returning a tuple (first, second, third, scandic_countries) where scandic_countries is a list of the remaining items.
hints: Tuple/list unpacking lets you assign several names in one statement.
A starred name in an unpacking assignment collects all remaining items into a list.
Use a, b, c, *scandic = countries, then return (a, b, c, scandic).
expected_behavior: Returns a 4-tuple: the first three countries individually, then the rest as a list.
explanation: Starred unpacking (a, b, c, *scandic = countries) assigns the first three items to individual names and collects everything after them into the scandic list.
